nodes.summary: Let $M$ be the Meissel–Mertens constant. Then $0.2614 \le M < 0.2615$, and for every real $x > 1$, $\left|\sum_{p \le x} 1/p - \log \log x - M\right| \le 1/(\log x)^2$, where the sum runs over the primes $p \le x$.
nodes.title: Mertens' second theorem with the Rosser–Schoenfeld error term

nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a Dickman–de Bruijn function. Then $\rho(x) \ge x^{-1.42 x}$ for every real $x \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Explicit lower bound for the Dickman function

nodes.summary: Let $\zeta$ be the Riemann zeta function. There are real numbers $C$ and $\alpha_0 > 0$ such that for all real $\alpha$ and $\tau$ with $0 < \alpha < \alpha_0$ and $|\tau| \le 1/2$, the point $s = 1 + \alpha + i\tau$ satisfies $|\zeta'(s)/\zeta(s)| \le 1/|s - 1| + C$.
nodes.title: Logarithmic derivative of the zeta function near its pole

nodes.summary: For every real $x \ge 2$, $\log \log x + 0.2614 \le \sum_{p \le x} 1/p \le \log \log x + 0.8666$, where the sum runs over the primes $p \le x$.
nodes.title: Two-sided explicit Mertens bound

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a real number with $\frac{1}{2\pi} \int_0^{2\pi} |\cos t - K| \, dt = 1 - K$ (this equation has exactly one real solution, $K \approx 0.3286$). Then for every real $\alpha$ with $0 < \alpha \le 1$ and every real $\tau$, $\sum_{p \le e^{1/\alpha}} |\cos(\tau \log p) - K|/p \le (1 - K) \log(1/\alpha) + (2 + 2K) \log \log(|\tau| + 3) + 7.28$, where the sum runs over the primes $p \le e^{1/\alpha}$.

nodes.summary: For every real $\alpha$ with $0 < \alpha \le 1$, $\sum_{p > e^{1/\alpha}} p^{-(1 + \alpha)} \le 0.9235$, where the sum runs over the primes $p > e^{1/\alpha}$.

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
